// env: Non-secret runtime configuration lives here so deployment needs only two interactive
prompts instead of seven. KIMI_API_KEY and SESSION_SECRET are NOT here and never
should be: this file is in git. Set those with `vercel env add`, which prompts for the
KIMI_BASE_URL / KIMI_MODEL below are set for a Kimi Code subscription key. For a
pay-as-you-go key use https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 (or .ai) with model kimi-k3.
GET /health probes all three and tells you which one your key belongs to.
